_doc: Single source for the visible surface of the atlas operating contract. Read by hooks/completion_gate.py (conditions n, o, p), scripts/atlas_todo.py (item phase, scaffold), hooks/todo_capture.py (Claude TodoWrite -> board) and omp/index.ts (omp todo phases -> board). The header text itself is defined in output-styles/atlas-orchestrator.md; scripts/turn_scoring.py HEADER_RE is a looser telemetry regex (matches anywhere) and is not this contract. A todo item carries its phase as: the omp todo phase name (lowercase phase id), or on Claude Code TodoWrite a content prefix '[<phase>] ' (for example '[verify] run the suites'). The three visibility conditions (n header, o phased todo, p colony channel) ask the model to repair presentation, so each blocks at most once per session.
